__usage_ai-training.description: `__usage_ai-training` is a policy token defined in an [Internet Draft](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kelley-aipref-training-preference-signal/) that Anthropic's Kevin Kelley submitted to the AI Preferences working group at the IETF to show a preference against crawling data for AI training.

GPTBot.function: Scrapes data to train OpenAI's products.
GPTBot.description: Data is used to train current and future models, removed paywalled data, PII and data that violates the company's policies.

AddSearchBot.description: AddSearchBot is a web crawler that indexes website content for AddSearch's AI-powered site search solution, collecting data to provide fast and accurate search results. More info can be found at https://knownagents.com/agents/addsearchbot

AgentTimes.description: Scrapes data for AI news aggregation and republishing.

Andibot.function: Search engine using generative AI, AI Search Assistant
Andibot.description: Scrapes website and provides AI summary.

Anomura.description: Anomura is Direqt's search crawler, it discovers and indexes pages their customers websites.
